subject: Pilot credits for Greenfield STEM outreach - request for extension
messages:
From: Dr. Maya Rajan <maya.r@greenfield.edu>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot credits request — Greenfield STEM outreach

Hi Irene,

I hope you’re well — I run the Greenfield STEM Initiative at Greenfield University (nonprofit/EDU). We’re planning a winter/spring outreach program for 10 regional community colleges where students will submit short programming assignments and essays that we’d like to analyze and provide feedback on using an LLM.

Our initial ask: would Redwood consider providing a trial extension or a pilot allocation of usage credits (we estimate ~600k tokens total across the pilot, ~200–250k tokens/month) and an embeddings quota for ~10k short texts? We’re a tight-budget non-profit and this would enable us to run a proper evaluation before applying for institutional funding next year.

Attached is our 501(c)(3) document for verification (Greenfield_501c.pdf). Happy to provide a short project proposal if that helps.

Key dates: pilot to run Jan–Mar 2027; kickoff in early January.

Appreciate any guidance on the approval process and whether a 3–6 month trial extension is possible for EDU/nonprofit pilots like ours.

Thanks —
Maya
Dr. Maya Rajan
Director, Greenfield STEM Initiative
Greenfield University

Hi Maya — great to meet you and thanks for the 501(c)(3) file.

Quick notes and next steps so we can move this through our EDU pilot process:
- Could you confirm expected monthly token burn and any peak concurrency requirements? You mentioned ~200–250k/month; please confirm an upper estimate.
- Please attach a short (1–2 page) project summary with success metrics (we can use that for approvals).
- We require a contact person for an MOU — who should we send that to at Greenfield?

Operationally, I’ll loop in our EDU/sales leads (cc’d) to scope an appropriate pilot credit package and a short trial extension. Typical pilot approvals take 2–3 business days once we have the project summary + confirmation of nonprofit status.

If you can send the proposal today, I’ll start the internal review this afternoon.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Strategic Accounts — EDU & Research
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com

Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot credits request — Greenfield STEM outreach

Hi Irene — thanks for the quick reply. Attached is a short project proposal (greenfield-project-proposal.pdf) with scope, metrics, and an estimated monthly token table. Summary below:

- Pilot window: Jan 3 — Mar 31, 2027 (3 months)
- Estimated tokens: Month 1: 250k; Month 2: 200k; Month 3: 150k (total ~600k)
- Use cases: automated feedback on short code snippets + rubric-based essay scoring using generation & embeddings for clustering
- Success metrics: 1) automated feedback accuracy >= 80% (human-eval spot checks); 2) embeddings cluster purity for assignment types >= 0.7
- Campus contact for MOU: Diana Lin, Program Admin (diana.lin@greenfield.edu)

We’re on a tight timeline — would appreciate a provisional answer by Wednesday so we can finalize student consent forms.

Thanks again,
Maya
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Maya Rajan <maya.r@greenfield.edu>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot credits request — Greenfield STEM outreach

Hi Maya — this is helpful, thanks for the proposal. I’ve started the approval thread with our EDU approvals board and finance. A few internal updates:

- We can provisionally offer a pilot credit package of 50,000 consumption credits (applied to generation/embedding usage) and extend the trial window by 3 months for EDU pilots while the formal MOU is processed.
- Final approval is subject to a short MOU and a signed data-use attestation (standard for student data). I’ve attached the HubSpot record for this request so Neha/Ben can track (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890).
- Can you confirm whether student data will be de-identified before upload? If not, we’ll need the attestation to include details on consent and retention.

Next steps:
1) Diana (cc’d contact) signs the MOU we’ll send via DocuSign.
2) You send the standard project contact + expected list of datasets.
3) Once the signed MOU is returned, we’ll apply the 50k credit and enable the extended trial for your account.

I’m cc’ing Ben to coordinate the DocuSign and the credit top-up. We’ll aim for turnaround by EOD Wed pending signatures.

Cheers,
Irene
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

I’ve initiated the DocuSign MOU (link below) and queued a 50,000-credit promo top-up for your Greenfield account once the signed MOU posts to our system. Please have Diana or the program admin look for: https://www.docusign.com/link/MOU-GREENFIELD-2026
